title: 법정 방청 및 촬영 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1

full_text:
Article 4 (Restrictions on Recording and Filming Activities)
(1) A person seeking permission from the presiding judge under Article 59 of the Court Organization Act shall submit an application by the day preceding the hearing date, specifying the purpose, type, subject and time of the recording or filming activities and the name of the institution to which the person belongs or the person's name. <Amended on March 23, 1988; and December 29, 2006.>
(2) The presiding judge may grant permission on an application under paragraph (1) only with the consent of the defendant (or of the plaintiff and defendant appearing in court): Provided, That the foregoing shall not apply where the presiding judge considers it appropriate in the public interest to permit recording or filming activities regardless of whether such consent has been given.
